title: Integration test for `merge-task.mjs` with linkage
description: Create `tests/integration/merge-task.test.mjs`. Set up tmp git repo with both `.tasks/` and `.issues/` fixtures + matching `.orchestrator.json`. Create a task whose description contains `Resolves ISSUE-042`. Run full merge-task flow against a fake merged branch. Assert: task shard is done + completed + notes; ISSUE-042 shard is resolved + completed + notes; both INDEX files regenerated; single commit captures both changes.
acceptance_criteria: Test handles both keyword + explicit-field linkage
Test verifies non-linked task path (no .issues/ touched if no link)
